title: Taxonomy Tagging Policy Compiler
description: Compiles the taxonomy and tagging policy. Enforces: vocabulary type declared, controlled vocabulary is non-empty when declared, per-content-type tag rules defined, tag counts are numeric, normalization rules cover case and special characters, and prohibited tags list is explicitly declared.

error_codes.TAX001: taxonomy-policy.json missing or invalid — required fields: vocabulary_type, contexts[], normalization
error_codes.TAX002: Vocabulary type not declared — must be one of: controlled | free-form | hybrid
error_codes.TAX003: Controlled vocabulary type declared but tag list is empty — controlled vocabulary must have at least one entry
error_codes.TAX004: Content type missing tag count rules — every taggable content type must declare min and max tag counts
error_codes.TAX005: Tag count min or max is non-numeric — min_tags and max_tags must be integers
error_codes.TAX006: Normalization rules not defined — declare how tags are normalized: case, special characters, whitespace handling
error_codes.TAX007: Prohibited tags list not declared — must be explicitly present (even if empty) to confirm governance was considered
